Everything at the counter

Built for the pace of a real shop.

No cloud dependency, no complicated setup, and no spreadsheet work after closing time.

01

Scan & bill

Scan barcodes with the phone camera, get instant sound feedback, and complete Cash, UPI or Card sales.

02

Stock you can trust

Inventory updates after each sale, with low-stock and out-of-stock alerts that are easy to act on.

03

Print-ready labels

Generate barcode labels for individual products or bulk batches, ready for A4 sheets or thermal printers.
